installCommand: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends openssh-server && apt-get clean
serveCommand: mkdir -p /run/sshd && exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -p {{port}} -o ListenAddress=127.0.0.1 -o ListenAddress={{address}} -o AuthorizedKeysFile={{keysFile}} -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o PermitRootLogin=prohibit-password -o StrictModes=no
